newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Strauss denies delays in Danone deal.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Strauss denies delays in Danone deal.

text.p: Nahariya Dairy Strauss denied on Sunday a press report that its deal with French food company Groupe Danone was being held up because of political uncertainty in Israel.

Strauss chairman and chief executive Michael Strauss said the reports were "nonsense" and that negotiations between the two companies were proceeding as usual, and legal and administrative issues were being dealt with.

Israel's daily Yedioth Ahronot quoted sources within the company as expressing concern that the political uncertainty caused by a right-wing win in the general elections and the bloody clashes of the past few days between Israel and the Palestinians would delay the deal.
Danone signed a memorandum of understanding in May to buy a 20 percent stake in Strauss for an undisclosed sum. A final agreement was expected to be signed within six months.
Strauss is one of Israel's largest privately owned food manufacturers.
